hints.title: Arithmetic Series Sum Equivalence
hints.text: The condition sum(1..x) == sum(x..n) simplifies to x * (x + 1) / 2 == n * (n + 1) / 2 - x * (x - 1) / 2.

hints.title: Perfect Square Check
hints.text: Compute total sum S = n * (n + 1) // 2. If S is a perfect square, return integer square root of S; otherwise return -1.

hints.title: Direct Square Root Pivot Implementation
hints.text:
```python
import math

class Solution:
    def pivotInteger(self, n: int) -> int:
        total = n * (n + 1) // 2
        x = int(math.isqrt(total))
        return x if x * x == total else -1
```

complexity.notes: Direct integer square root calculation in O(1) time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Linear scanning of all candidates 1 to n takes O(n) steps.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Reduces the problem algebraically to integer square root of n*(n+1)/2.
